tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows only cover short horizons, leaving the slow adaptation term and reversal at H≈22 unidentified. Acquire the available slow_horizon_discriminating_probe before fitting and confirming the candidate law.

considered_alternatives.option: author a sink-coupled dual-horizon reversal model from current five rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations are at H ≤ 0.48, so they cannot identify the slow adaptation timescale or confirm the predicted sign reversal near the target horizon H=22.
The evidence and selected branch rule point to slow-horizon discrimination, not an unresolved coupled-transient-lag mechanism requiring a trajectory batch.
It is not present in the available probe menu, and the current task guidance selects a slow-horizon measurement.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not resolve the horizon identifiability gap.
